parameters.content:
### One subject per run (blueprint)
In KlassApp each subject has its own submission; release waits until all subjects in the sitting are approved.

## Access rules
This blueprint only describes who may see and do what. KlassApp enforces these rules by role and by school.

## Rules (apply everywhere)
- A **save** is not a **submit**.
- A **submit** is not an **approval**.
- An **approval** is not a **release**.
- Nobody outside staff sees marks before release.
- Every query is scoped to **one school**.
- Every change is confirmed by a person.

States: Draft -> Submitted -> (Returned -> Draft) -> Approved -> Released

BLUEPRINT ONLY: no credentials, no real messages, no external calls. Never activate.

## School admin
- Assigns the class teacher (only place to do it).
- Reviews each submitted subject: Approve, or Return with a reason.
- Sees the combined mark sheet marked "Not released".
- Releases the sitting once every subject is approved, and chooses whether to send on WhatsApp.

## Class teacher
- Is assigned by the admin.
- Sees the combined mark sheet for their class (stream column + filter), marked "Not released".
- Can release their own class only if the school setting allows it (off by default).

## Subject teacher
- Enters one mark per student for one subject, or uploads a file.
- Sees marks already saved; blanks stay blank, never zero.
- Submits the subject (no message to parents).
- If returned, sees the admin's reason on the entry page and corrects.

## Parent
- Sees nothing before release.
- After release: results in the portal, report card available, can ask Toshi.
- If WhatsApp is on and the parent is approved and linked: gets the results_released template and can reply GRADES or tap See results.
- Can reply GRADES any time after release, with or without the WhatsApp message.

**Approved, linked parent:** a parent who linked their own WhatsApp to the child (by KlassApp number or by form), and whose link request the school admin or class teacher approved.

## Not in this version
- Nursery ratings
- Google Sheets import
- Whole-term sheet
- Release override

### Assigning a class teacher
This is the **only** place to assign, through one service. It asks for confirmation before saving. Replacing a current class teacher is logged.

### Portal
After release, linked parents see this sitting's results in the parent portal.

### Report card
The report card for Term 3 End of Term becomes available to linked parents.

### Toshi
Toshi is KlassApp's AI assistant; after release it can answer staff, parents and students about these results, within their role.

### WhatsApp template: results_released
Only if "Send results on WhatsApp" = Yes. Sent only to approved, linked parents.
"Hello {{1}}, {{2}} has released the {{4}} results for {{3}}. Tap See results or reply GRADES to view them here."
- {{1}} parent's name
- {{2}} school name
- {{3}} student's name
- {{4}} sitting (for example "Term 3 End of Term")

### GRADES
Parent replies GRADES or taps See results and receives the marks in the chat. Works any time after release, with or without the WhatsApp message. Before release, GRADES returns nothing.
